patient._comment: 'patient' contains the three sections that may be exposed in the detailed patient display: presentation, answer, and clinical.

presentation._comment: The immutable patient evidence package available for triage. Panel context controls whether other sections are locked or available.
presentation.quote: This tooth's been throbbing for days and now my whole cheek is puffed up like a chipmunk. It hurts to chew, hurts to touch — honestly I'd trade the tooth for a nap.
presentation.triageNote: 40-year-old male with several days of throbbing molar pain and localized tender swelling of the adjacent cheek. There is no drooling, floor-of-mouth swelling, voice change, difficulty swallowing, or airway concern.

answer._comment: The authoritative game answer. Explicit ESI, destination, and destination rationale are answer-bearing content; the player's assignment remains session state.
answer.destinationReason: ESI 5 is appropriate because a localized dental infection without airway or deep-neck warning signs is not expected to require a counted emergency resource.

clinical._comment: Display-ready clinical interpretation derived from patient.presentation. It preserves clinical meaning but must not explicitly name or identify the correct ESI level or destination; it does not participate in scoring.
clinical.summary: This patient has several days of molar pain and localized adjacent cheek swelling but no drooling, voice change, dysphagia, floor-of-mouth swelling, or respiratory concern.
clinical.acuityReason: The infection requires dental follow-up and medication but has no evidence of deep-space spread or airway threat.
keyFindings: Several days of throbbing molar pain
No floor-of-mouth swelling or voice change
teachingPoints: Emergency treatment does not replace definitive dental drainage or extraction.
Floor-of-mouth swelling, tongue elevation, drooling, muffled voice, trismus, toxic appearance, or breathing difficulty would require urgent airway-focused evaluation.

possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: Oral analgesia, antibiotics when indicated, and urgent dental referral for definitive care would usually allow discharge with strict return precautions.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, holding a hand to his swollen jaw
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a hispanic 40-year-old man with a visibly swollen cheek, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: seated, one hand held gently to his swollen jaw. Expression: glum and aching. Clearly visible: a swollen cheek and a hand cradling the jaw. No text, no logos.
